title: Tattoo Interview
description: Interview someone with tattoos. Ask them at least 3 of the following questions: What's the meaning of one of your tattoos; Where are you from; What was your first tattoo; Why did you get it; If you could remove a tattoo which one would it be and why?

title: Plank or Squat Hold
description: Hold either a plank (straight back, resting on forearms and toes) or a squat (fully seated position, hands out in front). Choose your poison and hold it for 90 seconds to complete the challenge. You get 1 attempt.

title: Pet Interview
description: Interview a person with a pet. Ask: owner's name; pet's name; breed; how long they've had their pet; most expensive/annoying thing the pet has ever done.

title: Monkey Run
description: Go to the nearest park or grassy area and do a 'monkey-run' (running on all fours) for 30 seconds. Provide video evidence.

title: I Want It That Way
description: Sing the first verse and chorus of I Want It That Way by the Backstreet Boys. You may Google the lyrics. Record evidence.

title: Seriously Call
description: Call any non-player and hold a phone call for 60 seconds using only the words 'Seriously' and 'I know'. If they don't pick up on the first attempt, or hang up within 60 seconds, it's an INSTANT VETO.

title: Kangaroo Race
description: Verse a non-player in a kangaroo race: jump like a kangaroo past two stores or buildings. Start at the beginning of the first store/building and finish at the end of the second.

title: Natural Rainbow
description: Create a rainbow (red, yellow, pink, green, orange, purple, blue) using only natural items (flowers, leaves, etc.). \n Take a photo of your masterpiece.

title: Cartwheel Challenge
description: Find a non-player and both of you must attempt a cartwheel.

title: Months Alphabet Race
description: Race a non-player to say the months of the year in alphabetical order. You do not have to win. No practice beforehand. Film only if they consent.

title: Five Birds Photo
description: You have 10 minutes to take a photo of 5 different species of birds.
